verdict.rationale: Reflect documents one-click publishing of individual notes to a public URL with minimal branding, which covers basic 'publish from inside the app,' but there's no evidence of a multi-note 'digital garden' site with browsable navigation or preserved working backlinks between published notes. missing for 10: evidence of a garden/collection view spanning multiple published notes, confirmation that internal links resolve to other published notes (working links) rather than just single-note pages, and any custom domain/site-level publishing.
